import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from scipy import sparse
import re
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import multiprocessing

multiprocessing.set_start_method("spawn", force=True)

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

train_val, val = train_test_split(
    train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train["author"]
)


def char_ngrams(text, n=3):
    s = str(text)
    if len(s) < n:
        return s
    chars = [s[i : i + n] for i in range(len(s) - n + 1)]
    return " ".join(chars)


TOP_FUNCTION_WORDS = set(

    ]

def add_text_features(text):
    text = str(text)
    if not text:
        return np.array([0, 0, 0, 0, 0])

    text_length = len(text)
    words = re.findall(r"\b\w+\b", text)
    word_count = len(words)

    if word_count == 0:
        return np.array([text_length, word_count, 0, 0, 0])

    punctuation = sum([1 for c in text if c in ".!?,;:"])
    capitals = sum([1 for c in text if c.isupper()])
    capitalization_ratio = capitals / max(text_length, 1)

    word_lower = [w.lower() for w in words]
    function_word_count = sum([1 for w in word_lower if w in TOP_FUNCTION_WORDS])
    function_word_ratio = function_word_count / word_count
    type_token_ratio = len(set(word_lower)) / word_count

    return np.array(
        [
            text_length,
            word_count,
            punctuation,
            capitalization_ratio,
            function_word_ratio,
            type_token_ratio,
        ]
    )


train_val_words = train_val["text"].astype(str)
train_val_chars = train_val["text"].apply(lambda x: char_ngrams(x, n=3))
val_words = val["text"].astype(str)
val_chars = val["text"].apply(lambda x: char_ngrams(x, n=3))
test_words = test["text"].astype(str)
test_chars = test["text"].apply(lambda x: char_ngrams(x, n=3))


train_val_text_features = np.vstack([add_text_features(t) for t in train_val["text"]])
val_text_features = np.vstack([add_text_features(t) for t in val["text"]])
test_text_features = np.vstack([add_text_features(t) for t in test["text"]])


word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    max_features=5000,
    stop_words="english",
    lowercase=True,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
)

char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(2, 5),
    max_features=5000,
    stop_words="english",
    lowercase=True,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
)

X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_val_words.values)
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_val_chars.values)

X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(val_words.values)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(val_chars.values)

X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_words.values)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_chars.values)

X_train_ngrams = sparse.hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char], format="csr")
X_val_ngrams = sparse.hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char], format="csr")
X_test_ngrams = sparse.hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char], format="csr")

X_train = sparse.hstack([X_train_ngrams, train_val_text_features], format="csr")
X_val = sparse.hstack([X_val_ngrams, val_text_features], format="csr")
X_test = sparse.hstack([X_test_ngrams, test_text_features], format="csr")

label_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
y_train = train_val["author"].map(label_map).values
y_val = val["author"].map(label_map).values
y_val_onehot = np.eye(3)[y_val]

model = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=2000, solver="lbfgs", multi_class="multinomial", C=1.0, random_state=42
)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val)


def compute_log_loss(y_true_onehot, y_pred_proba):
    y_pred = np.clip(y_pred_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    return -np.mean(np.sum(y_true_onehot * np.log(y_pred), axis=1))


val_log_loss = compute_log_loss(y_val_onehot, val_preds)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_log_loss:.6f}")

test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test)

submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test["id"].values,
        "EAP": [max(min(p[0], 1 - 1e-15), 1e-15) for p in test_preds],
        "HPL": [max(min(p[1], 1 - 1e-15), 1e-15) for p in test_preds],
        "MWS": [max(min(p[2], 1 - 1e-15), 1e-15) for p in test_preds],
    }
)

for i in range(len(submission)):
    total = submission.iloc[i][["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]].sum()
    if total > 0:
        submission.iloc[i][["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]] /= total

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
